line.text: Treatment begins in a hospital. Healing continues at home.

founding.text: Care Setu was founded on a simple observation: while Indian tertiary hospitals offer world-class clinical care, discharge often leaves families anxious, isolated and unprepared. We built Setu to bridge that vulnerable threshold with dignity and clinical precision.

lede.text: Eight services in three lines, across Noida and Delhi.
